description: This file implements a mock backend server as an OkHttp interceptor for a demo app, handling login, token refresh, and protected resource access endpoints.

classes.name: MockBackendInterceptor
classes.description: A Kotlin class that intercepts HTTP requests to simulate a backend server for authentication and protected resource endpoints.

methods.name: intercept
methods.description: Handles HTTP requests, providing mock responses for login, refresh, and protected resource endpoints.

methods.name: issueTokens
methods.description: Generates new access and refresh tokens with expiry time.

methods.name: readUtf8Body
methods.description: Reads and returns the UTF-8 string from the request body.

methods.name: parseJsonField
methods.description: Extracts the value of a specified JSON field from a simple JSON string.

methods.name: tokenResponseJson
methods.description: Constructs a JSON string representing the token response.

methods.name: jsonResponse
methods.description: Builds an HTTP Response with specified status code and body.
